item.title: Exactly Three Red Balloons

turns.text: Draw exactly three red balloons floating against a pale blue sky, each with its own dangling string. Keep them apart so I can count them. Square image, no text.

item.tests: Whether the final illustration satisfies an exact object count, colour constraint, and clear separation.

answer_sheet.Arrangement: Separated so all three are easy to count, each with its own dangling string.

must_haves: Exactly three balloons are visible, with no extra balloons in the background.
The balloon bodies are separated and individually countable.
Each balloon has its own visible dangling string.
The illustration has a pale blue sky background, a square frame, and no text.

turns.text: Could you draw some balloons for me, floating against a pale blue sky? I’ve had a simple balloon picture in mind for a while and would really like to see it made. There should be exactly three balloons, all red, and the image should be square with no text. Each balloon needs its own dangling string. Please keep the balloons apart so I can count them easily.

approvals.name: generate_image

style.prompt: A simple clean illustration of exactly THREE red balloons floating against a pale blue sky. Square composition, no text or lettering. Each of the three balloons has its own clearly visible thin dangling string attached to its knot, three separate strings total. All balloons are red. Space the balloons widely apart with clear pale blue gaps between every balloon and no overlaps, so all three are immediately easy to count. Arrange one balloon on the left, one in the middle slightly higher, and one on the right. Show all three balloons and their complete dangling strings within the frame. Soft gentle shading, cheerful minimalist picture, uncluttered pale blue sky background. Only three balloons, no extra balloons, no other objects, no text, no logos, no borders.
